description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging node that wraps Android's native Log utility. It is part of a logging chain implementing the LogNode interface, allowing log messages to be processed and forwarded through a chain of LogNode objects. The class provides methods to set and retrieve the next node in the chain and logs messages with optional exception details.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements a logging node wrapping Android's native Log utility, forwarding logs in a chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable; then forwards it to the next LogNode if present.
